title: Dual and plural set
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y8 lesson 3 (Pupil PDF worksheet: dual and plural set)
intro: Lesson 3: Dual and plural: rooms, nouns and adjectives. To understand how nouns and adjectives change in the dual and the plural

questions.q: Make the dual with an adjective: بَيْتٌ صَغِيرٌ
questions.model: Teacher: بَيْت + ـَانِ = بَيْتَانِ; the adjective agrees: صَغِير + ـَانِ = صَغِيرَانِ.

questions.q: Grammar set on the pupil PDF: ten items (make the dual with an adjective; choose the right plural adjective; write the noun after a number 3 to 10); then two sentences about your home using a dual and a plural.
questions.a: Answers per the key, for example: غُرْفَتَانِ وَاسِعَتَانِ؛ أَسِرَّةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ؛ أَرْبَعُ نَوَافِذَ
questions.model: Teacher does item 1: كُرْسِيٌّ جَدِيدٌ → كُرْسِيَّانِ جَدِيدَانِ.

questions.q: write 'in my house there are two bathrooms'.
Back to our ponder: why is the dual useful?
questions.a: It shows exactly two without a number
